description:
'I didn't know then. The fact that these things my father left behind, will devour my destiny.'

With his instant memory recall ability, Jin Yong-woon is attacked by an unidentified assailant, but he manages to avoid the crisis thanks to a mysterious artifact and travels back in time to the Three Kingdoms era.

Using the abilities he obtained from playing the game "Three Kingdoms Special," which he usually enjoys, he faces the Three Kingdoms period and embarks on a new journey with the escort of Zhao Yun and the Four Heavenly Maidens.
